auth.redirect: Login stopped because the redirect address was not trusted.
auth.risk: Douyin rejected this sign-in during a security check (code {code}). Please try again later.
auth.pollCode: Douyin could not confirm the scan (code {code}). Check for a message on your phone, then scan a new code.
auth.pollUnknown: Douyin returned an unrecognized scan status. Please scan a new code.
auth.network: Douyin's response could not be verified.
auth.credentials: Your Douyin session has expired. Scan a new code.
auth.expired: This sign-in attempt has ended. Scan a new code.
auth.sendFailed: Douyin could not send a verification code. Try signing in again later.
auth.sms: Enter the six-digit code Douyin sent to your phone.
auth.official: Complete verification on Douyin’s official page.
auth.noVerify: Douyin requires an additional check but did not offer a supported method. Complete it in Douyin, then scan again.
auth.scanned: Confirm on your phone. Waiting for Douyin.
auth.saveFailed: The account change could not be saved. Check local storage.
auth.requesting: Requesting a sign-in code from Douyin.
auth.qrFailed: Douyin did not return a usable QR code. Try again later.
auth.wrongCode: Invalid verification code. Check it and try again.
auth.accountChecking: Sign-in confirmed on your phone. Checking your Douyin account details again.
auth.accountFailed: Sign-in was confirmed on your phone, but your Douyin account could not be verified. Please scan a new code later.
auth.ssoFailed: Sign-in was confirmed on your phone, but the Douyin sign-in redirect failed. Please scan a new code.
api.temporary: Could not read Douyin data. Try again later.
api.cooldown: Douyin is limiting requests. Requests will resume after the cooldown.
api.signature: Douyin rejected the request signature. Check for an extension update.
api.verify: Douyin requires verification. Complete it on the official Douyin site.
api.login: Sign in to Douyin on the system accounts page.
api.notFound: The creator or post is unavailable or private.
api.unexpected: Douyin did not return the expected data.
api.invalidLink: This Douyin share link is not supported.
error.profile: Could not verify this creator’s profile. Try again later.
error.homepage: Paste a Douyin creator’s profile URL or a short link to their profile.
error.posts: The post list was incomplete. The next check will start from the latest page.
error.live: Could not confirm the live room’s status.
error.poll: The check did not finish. It will run again at the next scheduled interval.
